name: EQ Pegasi B
description: A star 0.25 solar radii and 0.25 solar masses that turns once in 9.72 hours; its magnetic field has been mapped.

radius.source: Morin et al., arXiv:0808.1423, Table 1: radius 0.25 solar radii (theoretical radius; R sin i = 0.23(1))

mass.source: Morin et al., arXiv:0808.1423, Table 1: mass 0.25 solar masses

temperature.source: Pecaut & Mamajek (2013, ApJS 208, 9), the online table's version 2022.04.16, row M4V, for SIMBAD's spectral type M4.0Ve: Teff

spin.source: Morin et al., arXiv:0808.1423, Table 1: rotation period 0.405 d and an axis 60 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with

text.card: A star 25% of the Sun's width that turns once in 9.72 hours, with a mapped magnetic field.
text.introduction: Morin et al. give it 0.25 solar radii, 0.25 solar masses, a rotation period of 9.72 hours and an axis tilted 60° from the line of sight.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2824770686019004032 (quality A), from 2018MNRAS.475.1960F; Gaia DR3 measures none
